§6Steam Turbine§f

§aThe workhorse that turns your reactor's steam into actual electricity.§f

The §bSteam Turbine§f is a single-block generator. Feed it steam, get HE. It has a §e1 MHE§f power buffer, §e64,000 mB§f input, and §e128,000 mB§f output buffer.

§6Crafting§f:
§b•§f 2× Steel Ingot, 2× Copper Coil, 2× Polymer Bar, 1× Titanium Steam Turbine

§6Setup§f:
§b•§f Set the §bFluid ID§f to match your reactor's steam type (normal / dense / super dense)
§b•§f Connect a steam pipe from your reactor
§b•§f The turbine steps down one density level and outputs power
§b•§f Low-Pressure Steam output must be condensed back to water

§6Density Chain§f: Super Dense → Dense → Steam → Low-Pressure Steam

The single-block turbine handles a §bZIRNOX§f fine. For a §bPWR§f or §bRBMK§f, you need the Industrial Steam Turbine. The small one can't keep up with the throughput.

§ePS:§f Check JEI for the full crafting recipe. Turbines are dirt cheap compared to the reactor they're attached to.
